action_note: Placed under the prior approval category and on the Ministry of Home Affairs watch list; reported as taken under section 46 of the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act. The underlying MHA order was not retrieved; sourcing is contemporaneous reporting only.

Removed from the prior reference category with immediate effect; MHA reported as asking the Reserve Bank of India to inform banks. Day of month inferred from the report's publication date and is not stated in the source. The underlying MHA order was not retrieved.

Enforcement Directorate statement records that the trust was granted permission under the FCRA, 2010 during 2011-12 for receiving foreign contributions from Amnesty International UK, and that the same was cancelled and permission or registration has been denied. No date is given for the cancellation, and the underlying MHA record was not retrieved.

Central government sanction reported as granted to the Central Bureau of Investigation to prosecute Amnesty International India and Aakar Patel under the FCRA, required by Section 40 of the Act before a court may take cognisance. Follows a chargesheet reported as filed on 31 December 2021 under Section 11 read with Sections 35 and 39. The sanction order was not retrieved.
